DirectX 12 Agility SDK headers, unmodified.

Source:  NuGet package Microsoft.Direct3D.D3D12 1.620.1, build/native/include
License: MIT (LICENSE.txt, the package's LICENSE-CODE.txt)

Headers only. The runtime (D3D12Core.dll, d3d12SDKLayers.dll) is not part of
php-vio: the application ships it, see the agility_sdk option of vio_create().
To update, copy the same files from the new package and run the D3D12 tests.
